description: PLATEAU's C02 building fixture read with every building, building part, boundary surface, window and door extracted as a feature of its own, then written back: the writer joins each feature under the object its parent key names, so every nested object's gml:id appears once, under the same parent and wrapper property as in the source, such as window W1 in wall WS1's bldg:opening. New-world only: the legacy writer writes each feature top-level.
